title: ElevenLabs System Tools: End Call, Transfer and Language Detection
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: ElevenLabs System Tools: End Call, Transfer and Language Detection.

System tools are built into ElevenAgents and change the state of the call, not an external system. This episode covers all eight, then goes deep on the ones every phone agent needs: end call and when it is added by default, transfer to a human with Conference, Blind and SIP REFER transfers, transfer rules and post-dial digits, language detection with its two triggers and the only-at-start option, and voicemail detection with a personalized message.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
